function.name: kernel_industries
function.description: List every industry held in the Care Net Cognitive Kernel, with its code and name. Call this first when you need an industry code for another tool. Returns framework reference data only, with kernel_release, as_at and the notice.

function.name: kernel_industry
function.description: Read one industry from the Care Net Cognitive Kernel: its subindustries, job roles, hazards, medical surveillance protocols (with bases from citable instruments only) and the citable legal instruments for it. Use a code returned by kernel_industries.

code.description: Industry code exactly as kernel_industries returns it, for example CONSTR or MINING.

function.name: kernel_instruments
function.description: List the legal instruments the Care Net Cognitive Kernel may cite: only those verified three ways, in force and not held. Each carries short_name (cite exactly this), full_citation, instrument_type, gazette_reference, effective_date, verified_on, review_due, scope and industries. Optionally filter by industry code.

industry.description: Optional industry code from kernel_industries. Leave out for every citable instrument.

function.name: kernel_protocols
function.description: List the medical surveillance protocols in the Care Net Cognitive Kernel, each with its name and its basis (citable instruments only; an empty basis means the basis is not yet citable). Framework reference data, not a clinical opinion. Optionally filter by industry code.

function.name: kernel_elements
function.description: List the Health and Safety File elements in the Care Net Cognitive Kernel: section, element code, name, the duty in plain words, the citable instruments behind it and any candidate instruments still awaiting verification (never cite those as a basis). Optionally filter by industry code.

function.name: kernel_search
function.description: Search the Care Net Cognitive Kernel by name across instruments, protocols, job roles and Health and Safety File elements. Returns at most 50 matches. Use short plain search words such as noise, asbestos or scaffolding. Never put personal information in the search text.

q.description: Search words: 2 to 100 letters, digits, spaces or simple punctuation (. , ' ( ) & / and hyphen). The characters % _ and backslash are refused.
